articles.title: Marvel's 'Wonder Man' Creators Embrace the 'Auteur' Label with Humor
articles.summary: At IndieWire Honors, 'Wonder Man' co-creators joked about winning an Auteur Award for a Marvel show. They thanked Marvel for taking creative risks.

articles.title: How 'Spider-Noir' VFX Team Stuck to a 'Dogmatic' Plan to Pull Off Complex Sequences
articles.summary: The VFX supervisor for 'Spider-Noir' revealed that the team had to be rigidly disciplined to keep stunts and effects in sync. One slip could blow the budget or the show's tone.

articles.title: 'The Vampire Lestat' Review: A Berserk Camp Remix That Dares You to Keep Up
articles.summary: The third season of 'Interview with the Vampire' is a rock opera starring Sam Reid as Lestat. It's thrilling, confusing, and totally committed to its wild vision.
